preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: The list p contains n distinct integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for query in queries if query[0] == '1' for v in [query[1]])
preconditions.description: In queries of type 1, the vertex v is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= m for query in queries if query[0] == '2' for i in [query[1]])
preconditions.description: In queries of type 2, the edge index i is between 1 and m inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output, int) for output in outputs)
all(0 <= output <= n for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output is between 0 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(output == max(p_u for p_u in reachable_values if p_u != 0) if p_u != 0 else 0 for output, reachable_values in zip(outputs, reachable_values_list))
postconditions.description: For each query of type 1, the output is the maximum value p_u among reachable vertices, or 0 if all reachable values are 0.
